query: SELECT TOP 2000 source_id,ra,dec,ref_epoch,pmra,pmdec,parallax,ruwe,phot_g_mean_mag FROM gaia_dr3_source WHERE CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS',ra,dec),CIRCLE('ICRS',331.0441465885212,-56.78284419511611,0.21213203435596423))=1 AND phot_g_mean_mag<20 AND ruwe<1.4 AND pmra IS NOT NULL AND pmdec IS NOT NULL
